clips.title: The story
paras: In Ameth'Aran, broken colonnades mark the ruin of a once-great Highborne city in southern Darkshore. Queen Azshara's nobles practiced arcane sorcery here before the Great Sundering shattered the ancient world. Now the vengeful ghosts of the elves who died here haunt the stones.

Before the Great Sundering, Ameth'Aran and its sister settlement, Bashal'Aran, were twin centers of Highborne influence along the ancient coastline. Favored by Queen Azshara, Ameth'Aran's ruling nobles devoted themselves to unrestrained arcane experiments. The sorcerer Athrikus Narassin governed from afar in the Tower of Althalaxx. The city thrived until the Well of Eternity collapsed and tore the Kaldorei Empire apart.
